title: Office Administrator
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
  
  

Job ID
  
68764084717
  
Date posted
  
09/23/2026
  
Department
  
G\&A
  
  

Eightfold is a global leader in an AI\-native enterprise talent platform, trusted by the world’s largest \& most respected Fortune 500 organizations. Our platform is built from the ground up, operating at scale across Azure and AWS, deployed in multiple regions globally, including IL4\-compliant environments for the US Government, supporting users in 100\+ countries and 30\+ languages. Today, Eightfold is at the forefront of agentic AI, delivering intelligent agents that actively drive outcomes across hiring and talent workflows, while much of the industry is still experimenting with prototypes. Backed by over $410M in funding and valued at $2B\+, we are defining the next era of agentic talent systems.
  
  

What sets Eightfold apart is not just the technology \& our mission, but the team behind it. We are a deeply technical, execution\-driven organization that values ownership, collaboration, and high standards. Our engineers, product leaders, and go\-to\-market teams work closely together — in person and across functions — to build systems that scale in the real world. If you’re excited to work on hard problems, move with urgency, raise the bar every day, and help build agentic systems that transform how the world works, Eightfold is the place to do it.
  
  

**Location:** Noida (100% work from office)
  
  

**Work schedule:** Monday to Friday, on\-site
  
  

Role Overview
  
  

We are looking for a proactive, detail\-oriented Office Administrator to own day\-to\-day workplace operations at our Noida office and to support select administrative activities across our India footprint, including the Bengaluru office. This is a fully on\-site role in Noida, five days a week. You will be the single point of contact for everything that keeps the Noida office running: facilities upkeep, vendors, supplies, visitor hospitality, and on\-ground logistics for joiners, leavers, and events. Alongside this, you will take ownership of certain company\-wide admin processes that are managed centrally, working closely with the Bengaluru workplace team and the People and IT teams.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Facilities \& Office Upkeep
  
  

Manage daily administrative operations of the Noida office and ensure the space is clean, well\-maintained, safe, and presentable at all times.
  
Coordinate with building management and landlord on maintenance, repairs, access control, parking, and common\-area issues.
  
Track and ensure timely renewal of AMCs, fire\-safety checks, pest control, and other statutory or periodic maintenance.
  
Manage seating, desk allocation, and meeting\-room readiness.
  
  

Vendor, Procurement \& Inventory Management
  
  

Manage housekeeping, pantry, security, courier, stationery, and other office vendors and service quality.
  
Maintain stock of office supplies, pantry consumables, and housekeeping materials; raise purchase requests and control spend within budget.
  
Collect quotations, negotiate with vendors, and ensure timely invoice verification, submission, and payment follow\-up with Finance.
  
Maintain a vendor master, contract tracker and monthly admin expense summary.
  
  

All\-India Admin Support
  
  

Own or co\-own selected pan\-India administrative processes as assigned, such as courier and dispatch coordination, welcome\-kit and merchandise logistics to employees across locations, centralised vendor or subscription renewals, and travel or accommodation support for visiting employees.
  
Provide remote administrative support to the Bengaluru office on shared vendors, purchases, invoice processing, and event logistics, and be available to travel to Bengaluru occasionally for large events or office projects.
  
Help standardise admin trackers, checklists, and processes so both offices operate consistently.
  
  

IT Asset Custody (on\-ground support)
  
  

Maintain the physical inventory of laptops and accessories at the Noida office.
  
Hand over and collect assets during joining and exit as directed by the central IT team; coordinate repairs and replacements with vendors, including shipment of assets to and from remote employees where required
  
  

Hospitality, Events \& Employee Support
  
  

**Manage front\-desk and visitor experience:** reception, guest registration, meeting\-room setup, and refreshments.
  
Coordinate food and beverage arrangements for daily operations and for meetings or events.
  
Handle on\-ground logistics for team lunches, festival celebrations, town halls, and monthly engagement events organised with the People Team.
  
**Support onboarding and offboarding logistics:** ID cards, desk and access setup, welcome kits, and asset collection.
  
Respond to and resolve employee queries and requests related to facilities and administration, and clear tickets within turnaround.
  
  

Reporting \& Coordination
  
  

Share a weekly update on Noida office operations, all\-India admin items \& open issues.
  
Coordinate remotely with the Bengaluru office on shared vendors, standards, and processes as needed.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  
4–5 years of experience in office administration or facilities management in a corporate environment, ideally a tech or startup setting; experience supporting more than one office location or remote employees is a plus.
  
Hands\-on experience managing housekeeping, pantry, and maintenance vendors, and processing vendor invoices.
  
Working proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and Outlook, and comfort with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Calendar).
  
Strong organisational skills; able to multitask and prioritise in a fast\-paced environment.
  
Good written and spoken communication in English and Hindi; professional in dealing with employees, leadership, and visitors.
  
Detail\-oriented, dependable, and comfortable owning outcomes independently as the sole admin presence in the office.
  
  

We are a team of self\-starters who excel in their fields. We believe in giving you responsibility, not a task. We want you to have ownership and pride in your work and see your work's positive impact on your colleagues, our customers, and the world. We believe in providing transparency and support so you can do the best work of your career.

title: Senior Professional, Civil Engineering
description:
We are seeking to recruit an ambitious and dynamic Principal Engineer for our US Transport and Infrastructure GCC team in Noida/Bengaluru/Mumbai to work alongside our US Head to lead on the technical outputs with the team with a skill set concentrated in either drainage or highways.


WSP Transportation and infrastructure, as part of the WSP Group, specializes in providing sustainable development infrastructure solutions from initial concepts, through planning to full construction implementation. The GCC team will provide a detailed design service highway, drainage and public realm (external works) design for strategic, both adoptable and private infrastructure.


  
Desired Skills
  

* The successful candidate will be a dynamic, self\-motivated individual who will take on a Leadership role in project work, focused on delivery to the client and technical excellence. The role requires management of number of projects and becoming involved in design at an early stage.
* The ability to plan and design deliverables per US Engineering standards for each stage of a project is a pre\-requisite and training and guidance will be provided where necessary.
* You can expect to be actively managing technical design delivery for number of US projects at any given time; a major element of the role will be to liaise with WSP’s US based lead design teams to ensure project delivery to agreed delivery schedule, quality and budget constraints.
* You will also be required to work with other locally based team leaders to ensure resources are fully utilised, identified and addressed effectively and any surplus or shortfall in available staff/workload are identified timely.
* You should be able to demonstrate a comprehensive knowledge of and experience in highway and/or drainage design, traffic controls, utilities, sign \& signals, clashes, digital delivery \& BIM as well as a wide knowledge of the current Industry development.
* Your principal role will be day to day project management, carry out concept studies and detailed designs, leading to construction design and delivery. You will be supported by a team of technical staff of various grades.
* The role will include technical guidance, project management, cost and quality control and work brief preparation to enable the team to produce detailed designs for technical approval and tender/construction use.
* The position will also involve internal client liaison, assisting in the preparation of fee proposals and financial control of projects when acting as a team lead. It represents an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.
* You will be responsible for ensuring your projects are delivered to budget, programme and technical standards and meet Quality, Sustainability and HSE requirements.
* In leading the design process, you will be expected to set clear goals for the team members, monitoring their progress closely and encouraging them to deliver appropriate and cost\-effective solutions to the agreed programme. You will also be expected to support those more inexperienced by technical review, mentoring and advice.
* Cultural awareness, an open mind and excellent English communication skills are essential requirements for the role.
* High degree of self\-motivation and ability to motivate others.
* Ability to work under pressure and with minimum of supervision.
* The role may include short term secondment and/or visits to WSP’s US offices for better understanding of WSP’s business, assist with acclimatisation to WSP methods of working.
  

Key Competencies / Skills:


* The successful candidate is likely to be a Professional or near\-Professional Engineer having 12 to 15 years’ work experience including at least 5 years’ in managing multi\-disciplinary Project, Core Design experience.
* Proficiency in In Roads, Open Roads, Civil3D, MicroStation and/or Geopak design software.
* Applied knowledge and understanding with AASHTO, MUTCD, and FHWA Standards/Specifications/Guidelines.
* Ensuring technical delivery of Highway designs, Traffic Control, Maintenance of Traffic, Signals, Signs \& Markings, Clashes,Digital delivery \& BIM related tasks as well
* Ensuring Delivery to budget, quality and programme constraints for the US and/or international market.
* Familiarity with US /UK highway and standards is desirable.
* Proficiency in Bentley softwares \-Open Roads, Inroads, Micro\-Station, Geopak, iTWIN, Navisworks, SYNCHRO
* Experience in other softwares, Civil3D, ACC, PW Generative components, Concept station, Dynamo, BIM, AI, similar design software.
* Applied knowledge and understanding with AASHTO, MUTCD, and FHWA, TxDOT,FDOT,GDOT, CalTrans or any other US\-DOT, DMRB Standards/Specifications/Guidelines.
* Proficiency in MS Outlook, and MS office (Excel, Word, Power Point) is expected.
* A thorough understanding and/or experience of using 3D Modelling, using Software such as Bentley Open Roads, digital delivery using iTWINs, Advanced 4D construction sequence using SYNCHRO would be a distinct advantage.

  
* Minimum 12 years of post graduate working experience in design of Highways /Motorways/ Drainage system for Highways
* You will have substantial postgraduate (or equivalent) experience and either have been awarded Chartered status (PE, CEng, MICE, MIHT or MCIWEM), have equivalent international qualification, or have equivalent commercial experience and responsibility.
* Good written and spoken communication skills and be fluent in English.

* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Senior Customer Experience Engineer
description:
**About Hevo**
--------------



Hevo Data is a no\-code data pipeline platform that helps companies consolidate data from multiple sources for faster analytics. Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150\+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.



Over 2,000 data teams in 45\+ countries use Hevo, including DoorDash, Foot Locker, Arhaus, and Santander. We’re top\-rated in the G2 Data Pipeline category, backed by Sequoia Capital, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, and operate out of San Francisco and Bangalore.


**Role Summary**
----------------



The Senior Customer Experience Engineer takes ownership of the CX team's most complex, ambiguous, and high\-impact customer issues, leading technical investigations through to resolution while keeping customers clearly informed throughout.



With deep specialization in JDBC\-based sources and integrations, the role acts as the technical bridge between customers, CX, Product, and Engineering. Beyond resolving individual tickets, this role is expected to strengthen support processes, expand the use of AI and automation, build technical depth across the team, and mentor other CX engineers — pushing the team toward greater speed, accuracy, and consistency in service delivery.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own complex, ambiguous, and high\-impact customer issues from investigation through resolution, with clear and proactive customer communication throughout.
* Act as the technical escalation point for L1 and Associate CXEs, offering troubleshooting guidance and helping the team avoid unnecessary Engineering escalations.
* Diagnose issues using SQL, logs, API responses, database behavior, and product internals — going beyond surface\-level troubleshooting.
* Partner with Engineering and Product on complex issues by providing strong technical context, reproduction steps, impact assessment, and investigation findings.
* Spot recurring issues and work with Engineering/Product to drive permanent fixes, rather than repeatedly patching the same symptoms.
* Participate in — and where appropriate, lead — customer\-impacting incidents and high\-priority escalations.
* Drive improvements to support processes, tooling, automation, and AI\-assisted workflows that cut resolution time, reduce repeat issues, and lower manual effort.
* Build and own technical depth in areas such as JDBC integrations, databases, APIs, and data pipelines, acting as the team's internal subject\-matter expert.
* Mentor Associate CXEs and teammates through case reviews, technical coaching, and knowledge sharing, and show broader team citizenship — covering escalations, contributing to shared SOPs/KBs, and flagging process gaps beyond your own scope.
* Own and continuously improve technical documentation, SOPs, KBs, and enablement material for the wider team.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


* Consistent ownership and resolution of complex, high\-impact technical issues, with strong customer communication throughout.
* Low rate of avoidable escalations, and high\-quality escalations when Engineering involvement is genuinely required.
* Fewer recurring issues and repeat contacts, with reduced dependency on Engineering over time.
* Visible improvements delivered through process, tooling, AI, and automation initiatives.
* Demonstrated technical enablement and mentoring impact on Associate CXEs and teammates.
* Effective, low\-friction collaboration with Engineering and Product on customer\-impacting issues.
* Strong ownership of incidents, escalations, and designated technical knowledge areas.

**Required Skills \& Experience**
---------------------------------


* Strong grasp of cloud technologies, databases, and integrations, with hands\-on experience troubleshooting applications end\-to\-end.
* Strong SQL skills and hands\-on debugging experience across databases, applications, and integrations.
* Solid knowledge of JDBC\-based integrations and the connectivity concepts behind them.
* Working knowledge of data warehousing, ETL, REST APIs, webhooks, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Familiarity with Java or another object\-oriented programming language.
* Excellent troubleshooting, debugging, research, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Solid track record in technical product support, including email\-based support operations.
* Experience producing technical documentation and enabling other technical team members.
* Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly.
* Ability to independently prioritize and drive complex issues across multiple teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* 3–6 years of experience in technical product support, application support, database/integration support, or a similar technical role.
* 1\+ years of hands\-on experience troubleshooting JDBC sources or integrations.
* DBA experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or similar databases.
* Experience supporting B2B SaaS, integration, or data infrastructure products.
* Experience handling customer\-impacting incidents and complex technical escalations.
* Experience with ETL or data integration platforms.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**About Hevo**
--------------



Hevo Data is a no\-code data pipeline platform that helps companies consolidate data from multiple sources for faster analytics. Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150\+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.

**Role Summary**
----------------



An Associate Customer Experience Engineer owns customer issues end\-to\-end, keeps unnecessary escalations to a minimum, and ensures every interaction reflects a high standard of customer experience.



This role centers on troubleshooting JDBC\-based sources and integrations, partnering closely with Product and Engineering whenever an issue calls for deeper investigation. The role calls for building solid technical depth over time, following and refining support workflows, putting AI and automation to good use, and adding to the team's shared knowledge so issues get resolved faster and more consistently across the board.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own customer issues and drive them to resolution within SLA timelines, combining structured investigation with clear, timely updates to the customer.
* Investigate issues by digging into SQL, logs, API responses, database behavior, product documentation, and other diagnostic tools available.
* Loop in Product and Engineering as needed, sharing the relevant technical context, investigation findings, and steps to reproduce the issue.
* Keep unnecessary escalations to a minimum by building strong product and technical knowledge and resolving issues independently wherever possible.
* Follow established support processes and flag improvements that cut down on rework, manual effort, and resolution time.
* Use AI\-assisted tools, automation, and diagnostic capabilities to make troubleshooting faster and more consistent.
* Build deeper technical expertise in JDBC\-based sources and integrations, along with databases, APIs, ETL, and related technologies.
* Add to SOPs, KB articles, onboarding material, and other knowledge assets the wider team relies on.
* Support teammates when needed and take an active part in team training, enablement, and knowledge\-sharing activities.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


* Steady SLA adherence combined with consistently high\-quality resolutions on owned tickets.
* A growing ability to resolve technically complex issues without outside help.
* An avoidable escalation rate that stays low and keeps trending downward.
* Customer communication that is clear, accurate, and easy to act on.

title: Director of Engineering - Infrastructure Operations
description:
Join OneAdvanced:
**Mandate:** To lead OneAdvanced's Infrastructure Operations function across AWS, Azure, and private cloud — building a resilient, incident\-free platform estate, scaling a high\-performing team of infrastructure engineers, and driving the shift toward an Agentic ZeroOps model that puts AI\-assisted and autonomous tooling to work reducing manual operational toil.**About the Role**
OneAdvanced's Infrastructure Operations function keeps our platforms — including IQ, our intelligent system of work — reliable, secure, and cost\-efficient across AWS, Azure, and private cloud. As Director, Infrastructure Operations, you'll lead this function in Bangalore: owning platform and cloud operations end\-to\-end, driving incident management and resilience, defining the processes that keep a fast\-growing infrastructure estate under control, and building a team of 15–20 infrastructure engineers, including managers.
You'll also help shape where the function goes next — driving the adoption of AI\-assisted and agentic tooling to reduce manual operational toil, working toward an Agentic ZeroOps future where routine operational work is increasingly handled
What You Will Do:
**Key Responsibilities****Platform \& Cloud Operations*** Own infrastructure operations across AWS, Azure, and private cloud, ensuring reliable, well\-monitored, and secure platforms.
* Set and uphold operational standards for monitoring, resilience, and patch compliance across the estate.
* Partner with infrastructure engineering team on cloud architecture decisions, cost optimization, and the infrastructure roadmap.
* Drive operational resiliency and disaster recovery for OneAdvanced product portfolio

**Incident Management \& Resilience*** Own major incident response for infrastructure and platform issues, ensuring fast, well\-coordinated resolution.
* Drive root cause analysis and ensure lessons are fed back into process and architecture improvements.
* Champion operational resilience commitments across the infrastructure estate.

 **Process \& Governance*** Define, implement, and continuously improve the processes that govern change, incident response, and operational risk.
* Own change governance for infrastructure changes, balancing delivery speed with risk control.
* Establish clear escalation paths and decision rights across the function.

**Team Leadership*** Lead, grow, and mentor a team of 15–20 infrastructure engineers, building both technical depth and leadership capability.
* Own hiring, performance management, and career development for the team.
* Build a culture of ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

**Cross\-Functional Partnership*** Work closely with Engineering, Services, and Customer Success teams to align infrastructure operations with product and customer needs.
* Represent Infrastructure Operations in cross\-functional planning and governance forums.
* Act as an escalation point for infrastructure\-related customer and stakeholder concerns.

**Driving an Agentic ZeroOps Future*** Define and drive the roadmap for reducing manual operational toil through AI\-assisted and agentic tooling.
* Identify practical opportunities to embed AI into monitoring, incident response, and change workflows.
* Build the team's fluency with AI\-assisted engineering tools, and establish where autonomous or semi\-autonomous operations make sense.
* Balance the pace of AI adoption with the reliability and governance the function is accountable for.


\#LI\-MP1
What You Will Have:
**You'll need*** 12\+ years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or cloud operations, including significant people leadership experience.
* A proven track record leading teams of 15\+ engineers, with strong hiring and talent development skills.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise across AWS and Azure.
* A strong understanding of private cloud and hybrid infrastructure models.
* Experience owning incident management for complex, multi\-service environments.
* A track record of defining and scaling operational processes, including change governance.
* Excellent cross\-functional stakeholder management, including with engineering, services, and customer\-facing teams.
* Strong communication skills, comfortable operating at both strategic and hands\-on technical levels.


What We Do For You:
* **Wellbeing focused** – Our people are our greatest assets, and ensuring everyone feels their best self to come to work is integral.
* **Annual Leave** – 20 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
* **Employee Assistance Programme** – Free advice, support, and confidential counselling available 24/7\.
* **Personal Growth** \- Regardless of where you are at in your career, we’re committed to enabling your growth personally and professionally
	+ **Development Programmes** – From Future Managers to Leadership Training, our development programmes help you get where you need to go
	+ **Online Learning Platform: SkillsHub!** \- Learning at your fingertips, anytime from anywhere. You can access our online library with relevant content for your career growth.
* **Life Insurance** \- 3x annual salary
* **Personal Accident Insurance** \- providing cover in the event of serious injury/illness.
* **Performance Bonus** – Our Group\-wide bonus scheme enables you to reap the rewards of your success


Who We Are:

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector\-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.  

We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.  

OneAdvanced is one of the UK’s largest business software and services companies. Based in Birmingham (The Mailbox), operating across the UK, Ireland, India, and Australia.  

Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.  

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.  

Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.

**Own Every Moment at NetApp**


At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.


Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real\-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.


**Professional Services Engineer**
==================================


Bengaluru, India
**Job category:** Professional Services **Job ID:** 136609\-en\_US **Job Summary**
---------------


We are looking for a **Remote Delivery Engineer** to join our 24x7 Storage operations team and service our Cloud and Managed Services Customers.
  

  

You will provide support to our customers by responding to Incidents, working on Service Requests, Problem Management and Infrastructure Improvements. Experience in supporting a varied clientele is essential as is a good understanding of NetApp storage\-based technologies.


**Job Requirements**
--------------------


To be successful in this role, you would need to have the following


* Thorough understanding and experience of the following components in the infrastructure stack – compute, virtualization and networks: (VMWare vSphere, Microsoft OS and Applications, Backup technologies).
* Working knowledge on Containers \& Ansible would be highly desired. Experience in Microservices and technologies like OpenShift, and Kubernetes would be beneficial.
* Experience in writing basic PowerShell/Python scripts would be a must.
* Experience or Knowledge in other NetApp technologies like CVO, StorageGRID, E\-Series, CVS, Cloud Backup, Cloud Secure, Cloud Sync, Cloud Datasense, Astra, Trident \& Amazon FSx for ONTAP would be highly regarded

Other desirable requirements are as below


* Windows, Linux server and related Operating Systems including monitoring and troubleshooting, administration, replication technologies, security hardening and performance, would be advantageous.
* Knowledge in ITIL methodologies: change, incident, problem and configuration management and certification are desirable
* Understanding of managed services delivery and entry\-level cloud certifications is highly desirable.
* Experience in writing PowerShell/Python scripts for infrastructure stack would be beneficial.
* Knowledge of IaaC (Infrastructure as a Code) tools – Terraform.
* Strong understanding of Storage protocols and technologies (CIFS, NFS, iSCSI, Fibre Channel switching and networks).
* Working knowledge of monitoring platforms, WANs, SANs, backup and disaster recovery platforms.
* Strong customer communication and documentation skills.
* Working knowledge of hyperscalers – AWS, GCP, Azure is desirable.
* Good to have NetApp cloud\-based certification like Technology Associate (NCTA).
* Built and maintained strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Infrastructure design, build, deployment, and disaster recovery testing.
* Positive, proactive, team\-orientated attitude with a flexible and innovative approach to work.
**Education**
-------------


Typically requires a minimum of 2\-4 years of related experience with a bachelor’s or any master’s degree or equivalent combination of professional education/training and applicable work experience.


At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in\-office and/or in\-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:**


NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.


**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**


At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.


NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise\-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.


**Our culture**


We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.


If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment \- make your next move your best one. Apply now.


**Submitting an Application**


To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.


**AI Disclosure**


For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision\-making.

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
At OpCord, we look for people who are FIT (Fair, Inclusive and Trustworthy) and share same values. Join us to build innovative digital solutions and help enterprises transform through Agile, AI and Quality Engineering.
  
Quality Engineering
### **Senior Test Engineer**


Bengaluru, India 3–6 years Full\-time
Strengthen release confidence through effective test design, exploratory testing and intelligent automation.



#### **Role Overview**


As a Senior Test Engineer, you will take ownership of quality throughout the development lifecycle. You will design and execute effective tests, contribute to automation and work with developers and stakeholders to improve release confidence.


#### **Key Responsibilities**


* Analyse requirements and identify appropriate test scenarios.
* Prepare, review and execute test cases.
* Perform functional, integration, regression and exploratory testing.
* Develop and maintain automated tests.
* Validate APIs, web applications and backend integrations.
* Record and track defects with clear supporting evidence.
* Participate in release planning, risk assessment and quality reviews.
* Mentor junior testers and promote quality\-engineering practices.
* Collaborate with developers to introduce testing earlier in delivery.

#### **Required Skills**


* 3\+ years of software testing or quality\-engineering experience.
* Strong knowledge of test\-design and defect\-management techniques.
* Experience in web, mobile or API testing.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one automation framework.
* Working knowledge of tools such as Postman or REST Assured.
* Understanding of Agile and continuous\-delivery practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills.

#### **Good to Have**


* Experience with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress or Appium.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Git.
* Basic SQL and database\-validation experience.
* Exposure to performance, accessibility or security testing.
* A relevant testing certification such as ISTQB.

#### **Education**


Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or an equivalent discipline.

title: Quality Automation Specialist, AVP
description:
Closing date for applications: 01/10/2026



Location Bangalore, India


Job typePermanent \| Contract typeFull Time


\#R\-00285685

  



**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------


In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.


So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.


**Job description**
-------------------


This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.


Join us as a Quality Automation Specialist

  

  

* In this key role, you’ll be undertaking and enabling automated testing activities in all delivery models
* We’ll look to you to support teams to develop quality solutions and enable continuous integration and assurance of defect free deployment of customer value
* You’ll be working closely with feature teams and a variety of stakeholders, giving you great exposure to professional development opportunities
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level
  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

Joining us in a highly collaborative role, you’ll be contributing to the transformation of testing using quality processes, tools, and methodologies, significantly improving control, accuracy and integrity. You’ll be making sure repeatable, constant and consistent quality is built into all phases of the idea to value lifecycle at reduced cost or reduced time to market.

  

  

It’s a chance to work with colleagues at multiple levels, and with cross\-domain, domain, platform and feature teams, to build in quality as an integral part of all activities.

  

  

Additionally, you’ll be:

  

  

* Supporting the design of automation test strategies, aligned to business or programme goals
* Evolving more predictive and intelligent testing approaches, based on automation and innovative testing products and solutions
* Collaborating with stakeholders and feature teams and making sure that automated testing is performed and monitored as an essential part of the planning and product delivery
* Designing and creating a low maintenance suite of stable, re\-usable automated tests, which are usable both within the product or domain and across domains and systems in an end\-to\-end capacity
* Applying testing and delivery standards by understanding the product development lifecycle along with mandatory, regulatory and compliance requirements
  

  

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

  

  

We’re looking for someone with experience of automated testing, particularly from an Agile development or CI/CD environment. You’ll be an innovative thinker who can identify opportunities and design solutions, coupled with the ability to develop complex automation code.

  

  

You’ll have a good understanding of Agile methodologies with experience of working in an Agile team, with the ability to relate everyday work to the strategic vision of the feature team with a strong focus on business outcomes.

  

  

We’ll also look for you to have:

  

  

* Experience in end\-to\-end testing and test automation, including Playwright
* Experience designing and implementing scalable automation frameworks
* Knowledge of Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Copilot Studio testing
* Experience integrating automated testing with CI/CD pipelines
* Knowledge of AI\-assisted testing and Quality Engineering practices
* Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills

**Welcome to our Bangalore hub**
--------------------------------


Located at Taurus 4, Bagmane Constellation Business Park, our new office stands as a state\-of\-the\-art hub for innovation and collaboration.


### **Key facts:**

**Senior Test Engineer \- Test \& Product Development**

**Job Description**
===================


ADI’s Hearable Audio Solutions Business Unit is looking for a Senior engineer in test product development at our Bangalore location. The candidate will become an integral part of the Product \& Test Engineering (PTE) activities for the development of mixed signal audio edge processors and battery management power products. The candidate will also be part of pre \& post\-silicon phase of the silicon development from DFT to silicon bring up / characterization to high volume production. The ideal candidate will be technically strong and will have demonstrated experience in testing both Digital and Analog/Mixed\-Signal (AMS) Products, working with cross functional teams like Design, Bench Eval, PD, etc., with ability to collaborate with ADI global teams and off\-shore subcons.


**Job Responsibilities:**
=========================

* Development of the ATE software solutions as per the specifications.

* Execution of the Test development phases of the projects including Silicon functionality, Characterization, Yield Analysis, Correlation \& Offshore Production release.

**Qualifications:**
===================


* Have a degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering
* Have 5\-7years’ of hands\-on experience in mixed signal or digital test.
* Have knowledge of the ATE software development and working knowledge of Teradyne Flex, NI and/or 93K ATE systems.
* Have good analytical \& statistical skills and knowledge of the Perl/C\+\+ programming.

title: ASIC Digital Design, Staff Engineer
description:
**Date posted** 09/23/2026
### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **18270****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **09/23/2026**

**We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. **You Are**
You have built verification environments that catch bugs before they become customer issues. Whether you have been doing this for three years or closer to ten, you have learned that verification is not about running tests; it is about thinking through what could go wrong and building the infrastructure to prove it won't. You understand that a well\-written testbench is half the battle, and the remaining is knowing which corner cases matter, and which ones are just noise.
You are comfortable working in System Verilog and UVM, writing test cases that exercise real scenarios, not just the ones in the specification. You have debugged enough simulations to recognize patterns in waveforms, and you know when to dig deeper versus when to loop in the design team. Protocols like MIPI UFS/UniPro, DDR, PCIe, Ethernet or USB are not just acronyms to you; you have worked with at least one of them closely enough to understand how transactions flow and where things typically break.
Working on a verification team means asking questions when the test plan does not make sense, writing assertions that catch issues, and tracking coverage in a way that tells you what you have validated and what you have not. At Synopsys, you will work on IP cores that go into AI systems, automotive platforms, and data centers. The verification work you do will determine whether that IP works when it ships. **What You'll Be Doing*** Build and maintain UVM\-based testbench for RTL IP cores, including agents, drivers, monitors, scoreboards, and coverage collectors
* Write System Verilog test cases and constrained random stimulus to verify functional correctness across different operating modes and protocol scenarios
* Develop and execute verification plans based on design specifications, identifying test scenarios, corner cases, and coverage goals
* Debug RTL and testbench issues by analyzing simulation logs, waveforms, and coverage reports to isolate root causes and verify fixes
* Implement assertion\-based checks and functional coverage models to track verification progress and ensure thorough validation
* Collaborate with design engineers to understand IP functionality, clarify requirements, and provide feedback on design\-for\-verification considerations
* Run regressions, analyze results, and work toward coverage closure, documenting verification status and outstanding issues

 **The Impact You Will Have*** Ensure Synopsys IP cores are thoroughly validated before they reach customers building AI accelerators, automotive systems, and cloud infrastructure
* Reduce post\-silicon bugs and customer escalations by catching design issues early through systematic verification and coverage analysis
* Contribute to faster IP release cycles by building reusable verification components and efficient test strategies
* Help maintain high\-quality standards across Synopsys IP products, directly impacting customer success and product reliability
* Support the development of verification best practices and methodologies within the Bangalore team
* Enable design teams to iterate faster by providing clear, actionable feedback on functional correctness and edge case behavior
* Build verification infrastructure that can scale across multiple IP variants and protocol configurations

 **What You'll Need*** 4\-8 years of hands\-on experience in ASIC or RTL verification for IP cores or digital designs
* Understanding of verification planning, test case development, and coverage\-driven verification concepts
* Working knowledge of UVM or similar verification methodologies, with experience building testbench components and writing test cases
* Solid System Verilog skills, including understanding of constrained random verification, coverage, and assertions
* Familiarity with at least one industry\-standard protocol such as MIPI UFS/UniPro, DDR, PCIe, Ethernet, USB or similar
* Experience debugging RTL simulations using waveform viewers and analyzing coverage reports to guide verification progress
* Experience with Perforce or similar revision control environment
* Basic scripting ability in Python, Perl, TCL, or shell scripting to support automation and regression management
* Ability to use AI tools like Cursor and GitHub Copilot for analysis, development, debugs and maximizing productivity.
* Have good communication skills, will be a team player, and will have good problem\-solving skills.

 **Who You Are*** You can look at a design spec and start listing the test scenarios that need to be covered without waiting for someone to hand you a complete test plan
* You are methodical about debugging, when a test fails, you do not guess, you trace through the waveform and log until you understand exactly what happened
* You ask questions when requirements are unclear or when a design decision seems like it will be hard to verify, and you do it early enough to matter
* You are comfortable working with design engineers who may be in different locations, coordinating on bug fixes, clarifications, and verification scope
* You track your own coverage and verification progress, knowing what has been tested, what has not, and what the gaps mean for overall quality
* You are motivated by the moment when your testbench catches a real bug, the kind that would have caused problems downstream if it had slipped through

 **The Team You'll Be Part Of**
You will join the IPG and SSG Group at the Bangalore Design Center, working alongside verification and design engineers who develop IP cores for a range of applications including AI, automotive, and cloud infrastructure. The team collaborates across Synopsys' global sites, and you will have the opportunity to work on IP that goes into high\-performance systems used by customers worldwide. **Rewards and Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.  


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

**Job Description – Manager: Life Sciences Commercial AI \& Data Analytics**

  


**Role Summary**



We are seeking a Manager in Life Sciences Commercial AI \& Data Analytics to lead client engagements that use pharmaceutical commercial, real\-world, and digital data to shape strategy and execution.



The role combines deep life sciences domain expertise with analytics leadership, client advisory, and practical knowledge of AI and modern data platforms. The Manager will frame complex business questions, design fit\-for\-purpose analytics and data solutions, guide multidisciplinary teams, and translate evidence into decisions across brand strategy, omnichannel engagement, customer analytics, launch, field effectiveness, and patient analytics.



The ideal candidate will be a credible commercial analytics advisor who can connect pharmaceutical market dynamics with data, technology, and delivery realities — ensuring that solutions are analytically sound, scalable, compliant, and useful to business stakeholders.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Lead Commercial Analytics Strategy and Delivery**
	+ Lead analytics engagements addressing market opportunity, patient journeys, segmentation and targeting, omnichannel performance, launch readiness, field effectiveness, forecasting, and brand performance.
	+ Frame ambiguous client challenges into clear hypotheses, analytical workplans, success measures, and decision points.
	+ Guide the selection and interpretation of pharmaceutical commercial and real\-world data, ensuring that populations, cohorts, business rules, metrics, and limitations are appropriate to the business question.
	+ Own delivery quality, timelines, risks, and executive\-ready outputs across multiple workstreams.
* **Shape AI and Advanced Analytics Solutions**
	+ Identify high\-value applications of machine learning, generative AI, and advanced analytics across commercial functions, and distinguish viable opportunities from technology\-led experimentation.
	+ Direct the design and validation of solutions such as segmentation, propensity, next\-best\-action, forecasting, anomaly detection, NLP, and AI\-assisted insight generation.
	+ Ensure responsible AI practices, including appropriate data use, transparency, human oversight, performance monitoring, documentation, and compliance with client and regulatory expectations.
	+ Explain model assumptions, limitations, and business trade\-offs to senior stakeholders in accessible language.
* **Provide Data and Solution Architecture Direction**
	+ Guide teams in designing scalable analytical datasets, reusable data models, and robust ETL/ELT pipelines across claims, EHR/EMR, laboratory, SP/HUB, CRM, sales, access, and digital sources.
	+ Set expectations for data quality, lineage, metadata, reproducibility, security, and documentation, and oversee resolution of complex data issues.
	+ Partner with data engineers, architects, data scientists, and visualization specialists to align solution design with analytical needs and enterprise technology standards.
	+ Promote reusable assets, modular code, automation, and cloud\-based delivery approaches that improve quality and speed across engagements.
* **Advise Clients and Translate Evidence into Action**
	+ Act as a trusted advisor to commercial, marketing, sales, market access, analytics, and technology stakeholders.
	+ Synthesize analytical findings into clear strategic implications, recommendations, and implementation priorities.
	+ Lead workshops and senior stakeholder discussions, challenge assumptions constructively, and build alignment around decisions.
	+ Ensure recommendations reflect pharmaceutical market dynamics, treatment pathways, customer needs, regulatory constraints, and operational feasibility.
* **Lead Teams and Build the Practice**
	+ Lead, coach, and review multidisciplinary teams, creating clarity on roles, standards, timelines, and expected outcomes.
	+ Develop team capability across life sciences domain knowledge, analytics methods, AI, data engineering, quality assurance, and business storytelling.
	+ Contribute to proposals, solution design, thought leadership, reusable accelerators, and the development of EY offerings.
	+ Support account growth by identifying adjacent client needs and articulating differentiated, value\-led solutions.
  


**Required Skills \& Experience**


**Experience**


* 7–12 years of experience in life sciences commercial analytics, healthcare analytics, analytics consulting, data science, or a related field, including significant responsibility for client and team leadership.
* Deep experience with pharmaceutical datasets such as IQVIA, Komodo, Symphony, Optum, HealthVerity, TriNetX, EHR/EMR, claims, SP/HUB, laboratory, CRM, sales, market access, and digital engagement data.
* Strong understanding of the US pharmaceutical commercial model and familiarity with global markets, including commercial functions, patient and HCP journeys, therapeutic areas, launch dynamics, and regulatory and privacy considerations.
* Proven leadership across multiple commercial use cases such as patient analytics, segmentation, targeting, omnichannel measurement, marketing mix, field effectiveness, forecasting, launch analytics, or market assessment.
* Experience shaping and overseeing analytics solutions using SQL, Python/R, BI tools, and modern cloud data platforms; sufficient technical depth to review solution design and challenge delivery teams.
* Experience directing data integration and engineering work, including analytical data models, ETL/ELT pipelines, data\-quality controls, lineage, and reusable delivery assets.
* Experience designing or governing machine\-learning or generative\-AI solutions, including model validation, adoption, monitoring, and responsible AI considerations.
* Demonstrated experience managing senior client relationships, multidisciplinary teams, project economics, delivery risks, and competing priorities.

  


**Domain and Consulting Skills**


* Deep pharmaceutical commercial and healthcare domain expertise, with credibility in senior business discussions.
* Strategic, hypothesis\-driven problem solving and the ability to structure complex, ambiguous client challenges.
* Ability to connect commercial strategy, analytical methods, AI opportunities, data architecture, and implementation realities.
* Strong executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, and storytelling skills.
* High standards for analytical rigor, data quality, documentation, and delivery governance.
* Inclusive people leadership, coaching, and performance\-management capability across diverse and distributed teams.
* Commercial acumen and the ability to identify client value, shape proposals, and expand relationships.

  


**Educational Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in life sciences, engineering, data science, business, or a related discipline.
* An MBA or advanced degree in pharma, healthcare, analytics, or a related field is preferred.

  


**Preferred (Good\-to\-Have)**


* Experience supporting US or global pharmaceutical commercial teams.
* Experience in oncology or another complex specialty therapeutic area.
* Experience contributing to consulting proposals, reusable accelerators, or analytics products.

  


**What we look for**



We look for people who can develop and implement creative solutions to challenging problems and work well with teams to accomplish them. We value an entrepreneurial spirit: people who are innovative by nature and continually explore better approaches, products, services, and technologies.



Helping clients solve complex problems and implement practical solutions requires intellectual rigor, commercial judgment, curiosity, and a clear understanding of what works in real delivery environments. We seek people who lead themselves and others effectively, foster inclusive teamwork, and consistently deliver high\-quality outcomes.

  


**What working at EY offers**



At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You will work on inspiring and meaningful projects, supported by education, coaching, and practical experience that enables your continued development.



You will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality, knowledge exchange, and opportunities to build new skills and progress your career.

description:
Bangalore, Karnātaka, India IT Ref ID: JR\-022096  

**Our Mission**


At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.


**Who We Are**


In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!


We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
**Job Summary**


As a Staff Software Engineer in IT Quality Engineering Automation, you will be the technical anchor and visionary for our automated testing and next\-generation SDLC ecosystem, operating directly from our Bangalore office. At Palo Alto Networks, we are transitioning from traditional QA to an **AI\-First engineering culture**.

  

  

We are looking for an early\-in\-career AI Engineer to build and ship custom Agentic AI. Applications across an Enterprise IT landscape spanning Salesforce, SAP, custom. Licensing and Entitlement management applications, and AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM platforms. You will work with modern generative AI — LLM orchestration, autonomous agent loops, tool calling and RAG — against real enterprise infrastructure, building agents that carry out multi\-step business workflows, act on data across these systems through their APIs, and hand back to a human when they should.

  

  

At Palo Alto Networks we are moving towards an AI\-First engineering culture, and you will not be starting from a blank page. You will build on our own internal AI platform tools for test generation, automation scripting, execution and quality reporting.

  

  

### **Agentic Systems \& Enterprise Integration**


* **Build agentic features:** Develop and maintain agent workflows using LangGraph, ADK, LangChain, AutoGen or CrewAI, including planner/executor loops, state handling and failure recovery.
* **Enable cross\-system integration and tool calling:** Connect agents across enterprise applications, including: **Salesforce:** REST/SOAP APIs, Webhooks, Platform Events, Apex Invocable Methods, SOQL and Flows. **SAP:** OData/BAPI services and business\-object events. **Custom applications:** Licensing, Entitlement, AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM through REST APIs, webhooks and message queues.
* **Build context grounding and RAG pipelines:** Use vector stores such as pgvector, Pinecone and Weaviate to provide LLMs with accurate, current enterprise context.
* **Define tools and schemas:** Create well\-specified tool definitions and JSON function schemas, including MCP tools, to support deterministic tool calls and traceability back to Jira.

### **Agent Quality, Safety \& Observability**


* **Build evaluation suites:** Develop and run golden\-set evaluations to validate improvements to agents and prompts before release.
* **Implement guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows:** Establish safety controls, rate limiting, fallbacks and clear approval handoffs, especially when agents write to systems of record.
* **Enable observability:** Instrument agents with tracing and metrics covering execution paths, latency, context usage and token costs, and use findings to improve performance.
* **responsible AI practices:** Follow company policies on intellectual property and data privacy, keep secrets in managed stores and require explicit opt\-in for steps that send content to external services.

### **Collaboration \& Growth**


* **Collaborate across functions:** Partner with Salesforce, SAP and platform architects, QE leads, product managers and security teams to deliver reliable AI features that meet business, quality and enterprise compliance requirements.
* **Learn the enterprise landscape:** Build an understanding of transaction flows from AI Custom Quoting and order capture through licensing, entitlement, provisioning and service management. Prior knowledge is not required, but proactive learning is expected.
* **Share knowledge:** Contribute working examples, reusable tools and reviewed code to strengthen AI fluency across engineering teams.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 1–4 years of professional software engineering experience or equivalent demonstrable capability.
* **Programming:** Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node.js, with sound fundamentals in data structures, testing and code review.
* **Backend fundamentals:** Practical experience building and consuming REST APIs, working with relational databases and handling asynchronous or queue\-based processing.
* **Hands\-on LLM experience:** Demonstrable experience with LLM APIs, including prompting, function/tool calling and structured outputs, through professional work, internships, open\-source contributions or substantial personal projects.
* **Agentic or RAG exposure:** Built at least one working agent or retrieval pipeline end to end, with the ability to explain its design, failures and improvements.
* **Integration skills:** Comfortable reading unfamiliar enterprise API documentation and determining how to integrate safely.
* **Version control and CI:** Comfortable using Git in a team environment and working with automated build and test pipelines.
* **AI\-assisted development:** Daily working fluency with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, with the judgement to critically review generated output.
* **Education:** B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* **Production agents:** Experience deploying AI agents or LLM features into production, including multi\-agent coordination or autonomous decision loops.
* **Enterprise application knowledge:** Exposure to one or more of the following: **Salesforce:** REST/Composite/Bulk APIs, SOQL/SOSL, Connected Apps, OAuth and Apex. **SAP:** OData, BAPI/RFC, IDocs or business\-object events. **Enterprise platforms:** AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning, Licensing/Entitlement or ITSM platforms and their supporting distributed services.
* **Vector databases and embeddings:** Experience with semantic search, embedding generation and vector engines such as pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant or ChromaDB.
* **Advanced retrieval:** Familiarity with Graph RAG, Corrective RAG, HyDE or agentic retrieval, and graph stores such as Apache AGE or Neo4j.
* **Model Context Protocol:** Experience authoring MCP servers, including tools, resources and prompts.
* **Cloud and DevOps:** Exposure to GCP, AWS or Azure, containerisation using Docker or Kubernetes, and serverless computing. Vertex AI experience is a plus.
* **Test automation:** Familiarity with Playwright, REST Assured, Selenium or PyTest.
* **Domain interest:** Grounding in B2B sales processes, Partner Relationship Management (PRM) or the Quote\-to\-Cash lifecycle.
  

  

**Ways of Working**
-------------------


* **Evidence over assertion:** Measure results before and after changes, share findings with the methodology and clearly acknowledge inconclusive outcomes.
* **Curiosity with rigour:** Explore new tools, validate them before adoption and understand the difference between a demo and a reliable system.
* **Ownership:** Take tasks from ambiguity through delivery and raise blockers early.
* **Builder’s bias:** Prioritise shipping focused, reliable capabilities that users can trust over broad features that only perform well in demonstrations.
  

  

**Growth Path**
---------------


* Join at the **AI Engineer** tier of the internal AI capability ladder, between AI User and AI Architect.
* Progress towards **AI Architect**, building expertise in: Planner–executor orchestration at scale. Multi\-agent systems with human\-in\-the\-loop controls. Event\-driven integration across enterprise IT systems. Model customisation.
* Access company\-funded training to support this progression.
  

  

**The Team**
------------


* Join a growing, passionate and dynamic team working on challenging, mission\-driven projects.
* Contribute to a people\-centric culture focused on creating an exceptional employee experience.
* Help expand what is possible in the workplace through innovation and collaboration

**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.


We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.


All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

* **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

**The Practice\- A Brief Sketch:**


Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture Supply Chain Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept\-to\-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.


You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision\-making.

**Digital Thread**

**Digital Thread** focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept\-to\-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real\-time, data\-driven decision making.

**Connected Twins**

**Connected Twins** build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.

* Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end\-to\-end supply chains.
* Simulation\-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment.

**Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role**

* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain and concept\-to\-service business processes

	+ Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) systems such as SAP PM, IBM Maximo, or Oracle EAM
	+ Corrosion management, mechanical integrity, and fitness\-for\-service assessments
	+ Capital project advisory and turnaround planning for industrial facilities

* Drive continuous improvement in delivery, leveraging Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, and a Management Operating System (MOS) to embed performance management and accountability.

**Thought Leadership \& Practice Building**

-----

About Bandhoo

Bandhoo is a Construction Technology (ConTech) company building technology\-led solutions to improve quality, transparency, and productivity across the construction industry.

We are building **CONSTRA, an AI\-powered construction quality platform**, and are looking for an experienced **Construction Quality Expert** with strong hands\-on experience in QA/QC, site inspections, snagging, defect identification, and construction quality audits.

This is a **hands\-on site quality role** for someone who can independently inspect construction work, identify defects, understand their root causes, and assess whether the work meets the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities1\. Construction Quality Inspection

* Conduct detailed site quality inspections and construction quality audits.
* Inspect RCC and structural works, masonry/blockwork, plastering, waterproofing, flooring and tiling, painting and finishing, doors and windows, false ceiling, plumbing, and electrical/MEP works.
* Identify defects, workmanship issues, deviations, incomplete work, and quality deficiencies.
* Verify construction work against approved drawings, specifications, BOQ, ITPs, method statements, and applicable quality standards.
* Assess the severity and impact of identified defects.

2\. Snagging \& Defect Assessment

* Conduct snagging, pre\-handover, and quality inspections.
* Prepare detailed snag/punch lists including defect description, location, photographs, severity, and recommended corrective action.
* Conduct re\-inspections after rectification and verify defect closure.
* Identify recurring quality issues and their likely root causes.

3\. QA/QC Documentation

* Review and work with ITPs, Method Statements, NCRs, IRs, inspection checklists, and quality reports.
* Maintain quality inspection records and documentation.
* Evaluate contractor workmanship against approved quality standards.
* Support the development of quality checklists, defect categories, and quality benchmarks.

4\. Support CONSTRA – AI Construction Quality Platform

* Use practical construction knowledge to identify and define real\-world defects and quality issues.
* Review and validate defects identified through site photographs and videos.
* Help develop standardized defect taxonomies, inspection checklists, and quality benchmarks.
* Provide feedback to product and engineering teams to improve CONSTRA's quality\-assessment accuracy.
* Participate in pilot projects and testing of digital inspection workflows.

**No prior AI or technology experience is required. Strong construction quality expertise is what matters.**

5\. Site \& Client Assessments

* Conduct quality assessments at construction and real estate projects.
* Visit project sites across Bangalore and other locations as required.
* Clearly communicate quality observations to site engineers, contractors, and client representatives.
* Provide practical and actionable recommendations for defect rectification.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* 5–8 years of hands\-on experience in construction QA/QC, quality inspection, or snagging.
* Strong experience in construction quality inspection and defect identification.
* Experience in snagging, pre\-handover inspections, quality audits, and defect closure.
* Strong knowledge of civil construction and finishing quality.
* Practical understanding of ITPs, Method Statements, NCRs, IRs, and material testing.
* Ability to identify defects through direct physical inspection of construction work.
* Good understanding of IS Codes and construction quality standards.
* Experience evaluating contractor workmanship and quality compliance.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent.

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience as a:

* QA/QC Engineer / Senior QA/QC Engineer
* Quality Engineer / Construction Quality Engineer
* QC Engineer
* Quality Inspector
* Construction Quality Auditor
* Snagging / Property Inspection Professional
* QA/QC Manager with strong hands\-on site inspection experience

Experience with **real estate developers, builders, PMC companies, construction companies, property inspection firms, or quality consultancies** will be an advantage.

Who Should Apply?

This role is best suited for professionals whose core experience is in **construction quality inspection and defect identification**.

If your experience is primarily in project execution, planning, cost/contracts management, or client coordination, with limited hands\-on quality inspection, this role may not be the right fit.

Your job title does not have to be "QA/QC" — if you have strong hands\-on construction quality inspection experience, we encourage you to apply.

Why Join Bandhoo?

* Work at the intersection of **Construction \+ Quality \+ AI \+ Technology**.
