title: Senior FI Specialist
description:
Role Description:

Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is a global powerhouse in online travel, connecting millions of people with unforgettable experiences in over 220 countries and territories. With a market value of approximately $120 billion and a diverse portfolio of brands such as Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com and OpenTable, we’re committed to making it easier to explore everyone to experience the world.


Booking Holdings Bangalore is a cutting\-edge Center of Excellence in Bangalore, India and a key arm of Booking Holdings Inc. Top talent from diverse backgrounds converge here to develop innovative solutions that drive Booking Holdings' brands and business units forward. We offer a vibrant and inclusive workplace that fosters creativity, growth and opportunities to make a real difference on a global scale.

  

From bustling cities to remote corners, Booking Holdings' travel brands span 220\+ countries. Our FinTech team powers the financial engine behind this global network. We craft bespoke payment solutions, blending security with scalability. These tools empower our partners, fueling their growth and enhancing traveler experiences. By supporting our partners' success, we strengthen the foundation of our diverse travel ecosystem.

  

We are seeking a seasoned **Senior FI Specialist** **(IC Role)** with 15\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance (FICO) and enterprise architecture. Operating as a lead technical authority and individual contributor, you will drive the architectural blueprint, end\-to\-end solution design, and technical delivery of enterprise\-scale Record\-to\-Report (R2R) platforms.


This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in SAP S/4HANA, high\-volume transactional integrations (specifically with BRIM), and modern enterprise financial platforms. You will serve as the primary bridge between Finance leadership, Product Managers, Technical Architects, and System Integrators (SIs), shaping the future of our financial tech stack, safeguarding North Star Architecture (NSA) principles, and ensuring zero\-defect accounting compliance across complex ERP transformation programs (including RISE with SAP).

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

#### **1\. Architectural Leadership \& Engineering Excellence**

* **Solution Architecture Ownership:** Own the end\-to\-end architecture and solution design for SAP S/4HANA Finance (R2R) across all project phases (Explore, Realize, Deploy, Hypercare), ensuring strict alignment between core accounting principles, business requirements, and system scalability.
* **Core FICO Domain Expertise:** Drive design authority across core domains:


	+ General Ledger (GL): Universal Journal (ACDOCA), parallel ledgers, document splitting, multi\-currency frameworks, and financial close automation.
	+ Asset Accounting (AA): Asset lifecycle management, multi\-GAAP depreciation areas, and integration workflows.
	+ Subledger Accounting (AP/AR \& FICA): Business Partner and Contract Account master data, posting areas, main/sub configurations, payment processing, and open\-item clearing.
	+ Intercompany Accounting: Cross\-entity netting, intercompany settlement routing, and period\-end elimination matching.
	+ Managerial Accounting (CO): Cost/Profit Center accounting, internal orders, margin analysis, and managerial reporting.
* **ABAP \& Technical Oversight:** Conduct deep\-code reviews, debugging, and root\-cause analysis. Guide engineering teams on SAP programming best practices, performance tuning, and database optimization (ACDOCA/HANA views).
* **WRICEF Governance \& Clean Core:** Review and validate WRICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms) objects. Drive strict "Clean Core" standardization vs. customization decisions to minimize technical debt and avoid unnecessary custom builds.
* **Design Governance \& Quality Control:** Review and sign off on Solution Design Documents (SDDs), Enterprise Structure Key Design Decisions (KDDs), and L3–L5 process maps. Ensure all designs meet strict audit readiness, SOX controls, and financial compliance standards.

#### **2\. Enterprise Integrations \& Ecosystem Orchestration**

* **BRIM Integration:** Drive deep integration designs between FI and SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) to ensure compliant order\-to\-cash, billing ingestion, and revenue accounting (IFRS 15\) flows.
* **Ecosystem Connectivity:** Architect robust integration patterns connecting SAP with third\-party and ecosystem platforms, including BlackLine (Intercompany Hub, SOX Certifications, Multi\-Source Reconciliations), OneStream/FinDB, Snowflake data lakes, and custom middleware (MuleSoft API gateways).
* **Reconciliation Integrity:** Validate end\-to\-end data pipelines (Subledger \-\>GL \-\> Reporting platforms), ensuring complete financial reconciliation, zero data loss, and zero breaks in double\-entry accounting logic.

#### **3\. SAP Transformation \& RISE Implementation**

* **RISE Execution:** Serve as the lead technical authority on large\-scale programs such as RISE with SAP / S/4HANA transformation programs across Explore, Realize, Deploy, and Hypercare phases.
* **System Integrator (SI) Challenge:** Partner closely with System Integrators to validate, guide, and challenge proposed solutions, stopping rigid template\-driven approaches that do not fit the enterprise's long\-term architectural vision.
* **Migration \& Cutover:** Oversee financial data migration strategies, cutover plans, parallel\-run validations, and testing frameworks (SIT/UAT) from a technical finance standpoint.

#### **4\. Strategic Influence \& Stakeholder Management**

* **Cross\-Track Alignment:** Act as an individual contributor thought\-leader and bridge between Finance, Engineering, Product Management, and external partners, translating complex business requirements into elegant system behaviors.
* **Domain Mentorship:** Foster internal engineering/architectural capability by mentoring junior/mid\-level engineers and architects on SAP S/4HANA best practices, integration patterns, and emerging technologies (e.g., AI/automation in month\-end financial closing).

#### **5\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**

* **Financial Process Automation \& AI:** Evaluate, architect, and prototype emerging automation technologies, including AI/ML use cases for intelligent anomaly detection, Business Process Automation, Document AI, automated cash application, AI\-assisted month\-end close (MEC) forecasting, and robotic process automation (RPA), to reduce manual finance effort and improve reporting accuracy.
* **Architecture Evolution \& "Clean Core"**: Continually assess technical debt across our SAP and connected ecosystems. Proactively design refactoring plans to decouple legacy custom code, migrating toward SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services, standard APIs, and "Clean Core" extensibility patterns.
* **Benchmarking \& Tooling Optimization:** Research industry best practices and stay ahead of the curve on vendor roadmaps (SAP S/4HANA releases, RISE updates, BlackLine innovations, BRIM enhancements). Identify opportunities to replace expensive custom builds with native out\-of\-the\-box system capabilities.
* **Engineering Thought Leadership:** Act as a catalyst for continuous improvement within the engineering track by introducing automated testing frameworks for SAP, CI/CD pipeline enhancements for transport manager

**What You’ll Be Bringing**
---------------------------

* **Experience:** 15\+ years of progressive experience in SAP Finance (FI/CO), with at least 7\+ years in solution architecture, lead engineering, or technical authority roles.
* **Role Focus:** Proven track record as a high\-impact Individual Contributor capable of driving architectural consensus without direct line management authority.
* **S/4HANA Expertise:** Successfully delivered 2 to 4 end\-to\-end S/4HANA greenfield/brownfield implementations or global rollouts, including international localization and multi\-gap tax/regulatory requirements.
* **Integration Track Record:** Hands\-on experience architecting FI integrations with SAP BRIM (Billing, Convergent Invoicing, FICA) and external subledgers/billing platforms.
* **Transformation Experience:** Direct architectural leadership in at least one full lifecycle RISE with SAP or S/4HANA Cloud deployment.
* **Technical Depth:** Expert\-level capability in analyzing custom ABAP code, debugging standard/custom SAP flows, designing complex APIs/interfaces, and structuring custom data models.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep familiarity with financial closing and reconciliation platforms such as BlackLine (ICH, Matching, Close Management) or OneStream.
* Strong understanding of modern reporting layers (SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BTP, BI/BW, Snowflake).
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum product management methodologies in enterprise software tracks.
* Exposure to financial process automation, machine learning in cash application, or AI\-driven anomaly detection in financial close operations.

**Where You’ll Be**
-------------------


This role offers a flexible hybrid model.

Find endless opportunities to solve our clients' toughest challenges, as you work with exceptional people, the latest tech, and leading companies across industries.

**Business Unit:** Strategy\&Consulting, Global Network I **Areas of Work:** Digital Thread and Connected Twins\| **Level:** Manager\| **Location:** Gurugram, Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad \| **Overall Relevant Exp:** 7\+ years

**The Practice\- A Brief Sketch:**


Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture Supply Chain Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept\-to\-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.


You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision\-making.

**Digital Thread**

**Digital Thread** focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept\-to\-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real\-time, data\-driven decision making.

* Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems.
* Digital Thread use cases involving connected BOMs, product traceability, engineering change management, configuration management, quality visibility and concept\-to\-service process integration.
* Current\-state assessments and future\-state operating model design that improve end\-to\-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision\-making across the value chain.

**Connected Twins**

**Connected Twins** build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.

* Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end\-to\-end supply chains.
* Simulation\-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment.
* Process architecture and future\-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision\-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Digital Thread and Connected Twin transformation programs from strategy through execution across product development, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions
* Develop business cases, transformation roadmaps and investment strategies for clients seeking to improve traceability, visibility, operational resilience and decision intelligence
* Shape Digital Thread strategies across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM, APS and supply chain ecosystems to improve product lifecycle visibility and concept\-to\-service integration
* Define Connected Twin strategies and use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, logistics networks, facilities and end\-to\-end supply chains
* Lead executive workshops and client discussions focused on value realization, operating model transformation, AI readiness, simulation capabilities and supply chain resilience
* Drive process architecture, future\-state operating models and enterprise decision\-support frameworks enabled by Digital Thread, Connected Twins and GenAI
* Lead scenario simulation initiatives involving network optimization, disruption analysis, inventory strategies, manufacturing performance, quality improvement and supply chain risk assessment
* Define GenAI\-enabled decision intelligence capabilities, agentic workflows and AI copilots that support operational planning and business decision making
* Contribute to pre\-sales activities including opportunity qualification, client presentations, solution development, proposal creation and business case development
* Develop industry\-specific offerings, consulting methodologies, reusable assets, accelerators and thought leadership related to Digital Thread and Connected Twins
* Partner with Industry X, Data \& AI, Supply Chain, Engineering and Technology teams to develop integrated client solutions
* Build and mentor high\-performing consulting teams while supporting capability development, knowledge management and career growth

  

**Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role**

* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain and concept\-to\-service business processes
* Strong strategy and transformation consulting capabilities with experience leading complex client engagements
* Ability to connect Digital Thread, Connected Twins, GenAI and data\-driven decision making to measurable business outcomes
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills with demonstrated business impact
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Strong storytelling capabilities and ability to communicate complex technology concepts in business terms
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams comprising consultants, data scientists, engineers, architects and product specialists
* Strong program management, governance and risk management skills
* Ability to manage multiple client workstreams while maintaining delivery quality and commercial performance
* Strong people leadership, coaching and team\-development capabilities

**Your experience counts!**

* MBA from a tier 1 institute with work experience in consulting or related fields preferred
* 7\+ years of Hands\-on experience developing digital twin or simulation\-based prototypes to model physical products, assets, operations or supply networks, enabling scenario analysis, disruption testing and performance optimization
* 
* Proven experience leading transformation programs involving Digital Thread, Digital Twins, Connected Twins, process intelligence, GenAI or enterprise\-wide business transformation initiatives
* Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, manufacturing operations, supply chain planning, logistics, quality management and service operations
* Experience with Digital Thread ecosystems spanning PLM, ERP, MES, CRM, APS, product structures, connected BOMs, configuration management and engineering change processes
* Experience leading initiatives involving supply chain visibility, control towers, decision intelligence, simulation, scenario planning, network modelling or operational resilience
* Practical experience with GenAI, agentic workflows, AI copilots, prompt engineering and enterprise AI transformation initiatives
* Experience working with process discovery and process mining platforms such as Celonis, Signavio or Power Automate Process Mining
* Exposure to industrial IoT, connected operations, digital manufacturing, Industry 4\.0 or smart operations programs is highly desirable
* Experience owning client relationships, leading workstreams, managing teams and supporting business development activities
* Industry experience in Manufacturing, Automotive, Aerospace \& Defense, Consumer Goods, Retail, Life Sciences, High Tech, Energy, Utilities, Telecom, Oil \& Gas or BFSI is desirable
* Experience implementing responsible AI, governance and risk management frameworks for enterprise AI deployments

description:
Job Description
**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026\.

 **About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced RF Planning \& Optimization Engineer to support the design, analysis, and optimization of 4G LTE and 5G NR networks. The role involves RF planning activities such as coverage and capacity analysis, propagation modeling, link\-budget calculations, frequency planning, and interference troubleshooting using industry\-standard tools like ATOLL, Planet, and iBwave. The ideal candidate will work closely with product development, QA, and customer teams to analyze network scenarios, validate solutions, and drive performance improvements. Strong knowledge of wireless technologies, Massive MIMO, SON concepts, and radio network optimization is essential for success in this role.

* **Role: RF Planning \& Optimization Engineer**
* **Location: Pune, Bengaluru**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full\-Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Perform RF planning, design, and optimization activities for 4G LTE and 5G NR networks to achieve targeted coverage, capacity, and quality objectives.
* Analyze and troubleshoot RF network performance issues, including coverage gaps, interference, mobility, and capacity constraints.
* Conduct link budget analysis, RF propagation modeling, coverage prediction, and capacity planning using industry\-standard planning tools.
* Develop and optimize PCI plans, frequency plans, carrier allocation, and neighbor relations to improve network performance and user experience.
* Support coverage and capacity scenario planning, traffic analysis, and Monte Carlo simulations for network expansion and optimization projects.
* Investigate customer\-reported issues, reproduce network scenarios, and validate software fixes within RF planning and optimization environments.
* Perform interference analysis and troubleshooting for LTE and 5G networks, ensuring optimal spectrum utilization.
* Execute handover parameter optimization, ANR validation, and mobility optimization activities to enhance network reliability and accessibility.
* Collaborate with Product Development, QA, Customer Support, and cross\-functional teams to resolve complex technical issues and improve planning workflows.
* Analyze and maintain site databases, frequency planning data, geographic information, and terrain datasets to ensure planning accuracy.
* Support SON\-based optimization initiatives, including Mobility Robustness Optimization (MRO), Mobility Load Balancing (MLB), and Radio Link Failure (RLF) optimization.
* Work with RF planning tools such as ATOLL, Planet, iBwave, or equivalent solutions to validate network designs and generate performance recommendations.
* Prepare technical reports, network performance analyses, and optimization recommendations for internal and customer stakeholders.
* Stay updated on emerging wireless technologies, including 5G NR, Massive MIMO, Beamforming, and cloud\-based telecom planning solutions

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* Strong experience in RF Planning \& Optimization for 4G LTE and 5G NR networks, with a solid understanding of radio network design principles and optimization techniques.
* Hands\-on expertise in RF propagation modeling, coverage prediction, link\-budget analysis, and capacity planning.
* Knowledge of PCI planning, frequency planning, interference analysis, carrier planning, and mobility optimization for LTE and 5G networks.
* Understanding of Massive MIMO, Beamforming, coverage versus capacity optimization, and 5G NR planning parameters and KPIs.
* Experience with Automatic Frequency Planning (AFP), Neighbor Cell Planning, ANR, Handover Optimization, and SON\-based optimization workflows (MRO, MLB, RLF).
* Proficiency in RF planning and optimization tools such as ATOLL, Planet, iBwave, or equivalent wireless network planning solutions.
* Ability to analyze customer\-reported issues, reproduce network scenarios, validate software fixes, and provide effective technical resolutions.
* Experience managing site databases, frequency planning data, geographic information, and terrain datasets for accurate network planning.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret network performance metrics and KPIs.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience collaborating across product, QA, customer support, and global engineering teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Exposure to 2G/3G planning concepts, telecom performance analytics, cloud\-based telecom planning platforms, and network automation frameworks is a plus.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

 **Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

description:
### **Job Description**


**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**



When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.



Build the Digital Backbone of Modern Manufacturing



We’re assembling a dynamic team to develop and scale our Manufacturing \& Supply Digital Platform—a next\-generation software framework that transforms how manufacturing and supply operations connect, collaborate, and optimize.



This platform is not an ERP system. It’s a purpose\-built digital layer that integrates data, processes, and resources across the entire manufacturing lifecycle—from design and engineering to production and distribution.



This initiative is powered by NVIDIA technologies, including the Omniverse platform and AI computing capabilities, enabling immersive digital twins, accelerated simulation, and intelligent automation. You’ll be part of a team that’s not just building software—but shaping the future of how manufacturing works through AI\-driven, collaborative, and scalable digital solutions.



As part of this initiative, you’ll contribute to:


* System Integration: Seamlessly connecting diverse manufacturing and supply systems, data sources, and workflows into a unified digital ecosystem.
* Data\-Driven Decision Making: Harnessing real\-time data collection, analysis, and visualization to deliver actionable insights and operational intelligence.
* Automation \& Optimization: Driving efficiency through intelligent scheduling, predictive maintenance, and quality control—without replacing core transactional systems.
* Enhanced Collaboration: Enabling transparent communication and coordination across teams, functions, and geographies.


If you're passionate about digital platforms, industrial innovation, and working with cutting\-edge technologies—this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Lead architectural design and development of generative/optimization models for process simulation, process scheduling, and predictive analytics in manufacturing.
* Orchestrate pipelines integrating synthetic data generation, model training, validation, and deployment.
* Implement advanced optimization: multi\-objective, non\-linear, evolutionary, and constraint\-based approaches for process efficiency (e.g., scheduling, logistics, yield predictions).
* Guide the integration of embedded AI \& Gen AI solutions with real\-time industrial data streams, ensuring high\-throughput, high\-availability, and low\-latency deployment.
* Mentor teams in coding best practices, simulation\-modelling, and deployment workflows using latest industrial AI stacks.

### **Required Skills**


* Strong experience with Generative AI models. Hands\-on experience with Amazon bedrock and AWS AI\-ML services
* Proficiency in building and managing Agentic AI systems using frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen or similar.
* Expertise on cloud\-native architecture, LLMOps and MLOps tools.
* Familiarity with security, cost and governance best practices for Gen AI on cloud environments.


**Nice to Have Skills:**


* Previous leadership in deploying ML pipelines and automation (CI/CD, containerization) at scale.
* Knowledge of quantization\-aware training, model pruning, and NVIDIA\-specific deployment tools (TensorRT, DeepStream SDK).
* Working knowledge of OpenUSD scene graphs, data schemas, and extension development for Omniverse Kit/Composer.
* Published research, open\-source contributions, or patents in simulation\-driven manufacturing AI or optimization.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA’s AI stack— RAPIDS, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, cuOpt (or similar)
* Applied industrial AI expertise: root\-cause analysis, predictive maintenance, digital twin calibration.


**Educational Background:** Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, mathematics, or a similar field with quantitative coursework, and 7\-10 years of professional experience in associated field is required, a Master’s degree and 4\-6 years of experience, or a PhD and 1\-3 years of experience in relevant field.



This position requires working onsite five days a week.



Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.


**Posting Dates:**



September 16, 2026 \- October 1, 2026



Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Tech, M. Tech Only

* Proven ability to embed quality gates in CI/CD pipelines — linting, static analysis, test coverage thresholds, security scanning, and automated regression.
* Strong understanding of quality management principles: defect prevention strategies, root cause analysis, test planning, quality metrics, and continuous quality improvement across the product lifecycle.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to articulate technical decisions to both engineering and business audiences.
* Proven ability to mentor and lead engineers across multiple teams; strong track record of raising the technical and quality bar.

**What You’ll Do*** Own and evolve the application architecture for full\-stack systems built on .NET (C\#, ASP.NET Core) and Angular/React, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and quality by design.
* Design quality\-first architectures: embed testability, observability, fault isolation, and graceful degradation as first\-class architectural concerns — not afterthoughts.

* Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and architectural decision records (ADRs) that raise the quality bar across all product engineering teams.

* Drive cross\-team technical alignment: review system designs, conduct architecture reviews, and ensure consistency across services and modules.
* Mentor and coach senior and mid\-level engineers on architecture principles, quality engineering practices, AI tool adoption, and full\-stack development excellence.
* Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, AI/ML frameworks, and quality tools to continuously improve engineering velocity, reliability, and product quality.
* Prepare and maintain architectural documentation including system design documents, ADRs, runbooks, and quality engineering playbooks.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement — run blameless postmortems, quality retrospectives, and proactively identify architectural debt and quality risks.

 **You may have other skills, including**  

Experience with the following technologies a plus* Experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, ECS/EKS, CloudWatch) or equivalent cloud platforms (Azure, GCP).
* Experience with containerisation and orchestration tools — Docker \& Kubernetes — and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD, TeamCity, Octopus Deploy, or similar build/release tooling.
* Experience with API management platforms such as Apigee and local development workflow tools like Tilt.
* Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, or similar — including defining SLIs, SLOs, and alerting strategies.

title: Applications Engineering, Sr Engineer - PrimeTime
description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You treat ambiguity as an invitation to bring clarity, not as a reason to slow down. Stepping into complex, high\-stakes moments with a steady presence comes naturally to you. You listen carefully for what's unsaid, ask the questions that unlock momentum, and align people around the real problem, not just the loudest symptom. Tight timelines and high expectations energize you because you know how to prioritize what matters, communicate tradeoffs early, and keep progress visible without creating noise.


Partnership over posturing defines how you approach customers and internal teams. The back\-and\-forth of discovery energizes you, and you naturally translate between technical, business, and everything in between so decisions get made with confidence. You don't just deliver answers. You build trust by being transparent, direct, and constructive, especially when the message is hard. When something breaks, curiosity and methodical thinking guide you as you trace causes with patience while keeping the bigger picture in view.


Constantly looking for leverage is part of who you are. Patterns reveal themselves to you, one\-off fixes become repeatable playbooks, and you leave behind cleaner processes than you found. Precision balanced with pragmatism helps you know when to go deep and when to move forward with a well\-framed assumption. Above all, you bring a collaborative intensity that is calm, driven, and generous, helping the team move faster together while keeping quality and integrity non\-negotiable.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

title: Applications Engineering, Sr Engineer (FPGA, RTL Design & Emulation)
description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India


**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18858 **Date posted** 09/16/2026
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent the last few years deep in FPGA design and implementation, and you have learned that the real work begins when a customer's design does not compile the way they expected or when partitioning across multiple FPGAs creates timing issues no one saw coming. You are the engineer who stays on the call until the problem is solved, not because you have to, but because leaving something half\-fixed bothers you.


You are comfortable reading Verilog or SystemVerilog that someone else wrote, understanding what they were trying to do, and figuring out why the synthesis tool is choking on it. You know your way around FPGA architecture well enough to explain why a design that worked fine in simulation is failing in hardware, and you can do it in a way that does not make the customer feel like they missed something obvious.


Working with customers energizes you. You like the variety of problems, the pressure of real deadlines, and the satisfaction of helping someone get unstuck. You do not need everything documented perfectly to move forward. You ask the right questions, dig into log files, reproduce issues locally, and escalate to R\&D when needed with enough context that they can actually help.


At Synopsys, you will work with some of the most complex emulation and prototyping workflows in the industry, supporting global customers who depend on Zebu and Protocompiler to verify chips that power everything from automotive systems to data centers.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Provide technical support to global customers using Synopsys Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping software, troubleshooting issues across partitioning, synthesis, place and route, and hardware debug
* Work directly with customers to migrate their designs to new software releases, ensuring compatibility and resolving any regressions or performance issues that surface
* Deploy new software features on live customer designs, helping them adopt capabilities like advanced partitioning algorithms, new debug modes, or updated FPGA target support
* Deliver technical training sessions to customers, ranging from basic tool usage to advanced workflows for multi\-FPGA partitioning and hardware\-software co\-verification
* Collaborate with Synopsys HAV R\&D teams to report customer issues, provide reproducible test cases, and advocate for product improvements based on real\-world usage patterns
* Support pre\-sales evaluations by running customer designs through the Synopsys emulation and prototyping flow, demonstrating performance and identifying potential adoption blockers
* Travel occasionally to customer sites for onsite support, training, or critical issue resolution

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable customers to bring up complex SoC designs on emulation and prototyping platforms faster, reducing their verification cycle time by weeks or months
* Improve product quality by surfacing real customer pain points to R\&D with enough technical detail that fixes can be prioritized and implemented effectively
* Build customer confidence in Synopsys HAV solutions through responsive, expert\-level support that helps them solve problems they could not solve on their own
* Expand adoption of new software features by showing customers how to use them on their actual designs, not just in demos
* Reduce escalations and support load over time by delivering training that helps customers become more self\-sufficient with the toolchain
* Strengthen customer relationships by being the engineer they trust to pick up the phone when something is broken and production timelines are at risk
* Contribute to the technical knowledge base and internal best practices that make the entire support organization more effective

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelors in Electronics Engineering with 2\-3 years of experience, or Master's in Electronics Engineering with 1\-2 years, specifically in emulation or prototyping environments
* Hands\-on experience with logic design and implementation using FPGAs, including synthesis, place and route, and timing closure
* Strong working knowledge of Verilog, System Verilog, or VHDL, including the ability to read, debug, and modify RTL written by others
* Practical experience with FPGA architecture and back\-end implementation flows, including understanding of resource utilization, clock domain crossing, and design partitioning
* Exposure to Xilinx or Altera synthesis tools is a plus, as is familiarity with Synopsys Prototyping or Emulation hardware and software
* Experience with interface protocols like PCIe, AXI, UART, or I2C is a plus, particularly in the context of hardware\-software integration
* Scripting experience in Python, Tcl, or shell is desirable for automating workflows and analyzing log files

### **Who You Are**

* You can take a vague customer complaint like "the compile is failing" and turn it into a specific, reproducible issue with enough detail that R\&D can act on it
* You stay calm when a customer is frustrated or under pressure, and you focus on solving the problem rather than defending the tool
* You are comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple customer issues in parallel without losing track of who needs what by when
* You do not mind digging through synthesis logs, waveform dumps, or FPGA utilization reports to find the root cause of a problem
* You can explain a complex technical tradeoff, like why a design needs to be repartitioned or why certain optimizations are not possible, in a way that makes sense to someone who is not an FPGA expert
* You are open to occasional travel for customer support, training, or onsite troubleshooting when remote support is not enough

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You will join Synopsys Technical Sales Group (TSG) as part of the Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV) team, working alongside expert\-level field engineers who support customers globally on Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping solutions. The team works closely with R\&D and directly with customers at all stages of the emulation and prototyping cycle, from pre\-sales evaluation through post\-deployment support. You will collaborate with engineers across geographies and gain exposure to Synopsys HAV hardware platforms as part of your technical development.


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Senior Engineer - Network
description:
**Job Title: Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer**

**Location\- Pune/Bangalore**

 **What you will do:**

  

As part of JCI’s ongoing and exciting digital transformation strategy, as a Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer you will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert across our global Enterprise Security estate. You will work with the wider global network and IT teams, business partners and managed service vendors to design, engineer and operate the physical and logical Enterprise Security infrastructure (Zscaler Secure Service Edge, firewalls, remote access platforms, cloud proxies, microsegmentation (Zscaler and Guardicore), cloud security \& perimeter security devices etc.) portfolio in Johnson Controls. This is a senior, hands\-on role with a strong emphasis on our Zscaler platform – including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Zscaler AI Security – underpinning JCI’s Zero Trust program.

  



Our Network infrastructure consists of a large global footprint of more than one thousand sites supporting over one hundred thousand employees ranging from datacenters, manufacturing plants, sales branches, and customer contact centers with exposure to a wide range of exciting network technologies and vendors such as Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, DLP, AI Security and Microsegmentation), Fortinet, Zscaler ZT Branch Connector, Akamai Guardicore, Imperva WAF, Forescout, Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS and many more partners.

  

The role will be working as part of a global high\-performance team focused on continuous network security infrastructure delivery and upgrades, maintenance and operational activities, delivery of security configurations and services, incident and change management, network security design and compliance, equipment ordering, scheduling, security device life cycle management, operational handover, vendor management and network security infrastructure asset management.

 **How you will do it:**

* Manage and implement network security infrastructure
* Serve as senior engineer and design authority for the Zscaler platform – ZIA, ZPA, Inline DLP, AI Security (Secure AI Access), Digital Experience (ZDX) and Zscaler Microsegmentation
* Build and tune ZIA/ZPA access policies, SSL inspection, DLP dictionaries and AI Security controls, and lead the migration of users to full SSE capability
* Firewall, IPS/IDS and remote access configuration and rule management across the Fortinet estate (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer)
* Cloud\-based Web Application Firewall (Imperva WAF), microsegmentation and workload protection (Zscaler and Akamai Guardicore), and perimeter/geo\-blocking controls
* Design, build, operate and automate security solutions and processes to protect the integrity of the organization's networks, systems, applications and data.
* Work closely with Security team partners/Business Relationship Managers , Field IT leadership and managed service suppliers to ensure successful identification and timely delivery of network security services to the business.
* Participate and consult(in partnership with the Network lifecycle refresh team) the identification, selection and prioritization of security infrastructure refresh components to ensure alignment with risk avoidance, strategic goals and organizational priorities.
* Respond to security incidents, including data breaches, and coordinate with other IT teams to mitigate the impact of any security breaches.
* Conduct regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities in the network and implement measures to address them.
* Partner with IT audit to remediate security gaps in a timley manner.
* Drive and develop automation opportunities for the management of security infrastructure.
* Manage the global Network security infrastrucutre inventory in CMDB.
* Ensure timely quote turnaround for security infrastructure delivery.
* Ensure all network asset data is accurate and support contracts are in place.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and operations staff, set standards and act as an escalation point for complex incidents and designs.
* Lead delivery of the Zero Trust program, including microsegmentation of crown\-jewel applications with Zscaler and Guardicore, geo\-blocking and reduction of the internet\-facing attack surface.
 **What we look for:**

**Required**

* Deep, hands\-on expertise with the Zscaler platform is essential – Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler DLP and Zscaler AI Security (Secure AI Access), including policy design, SSL inspection, App Connectors/Service Edges and tenant administration.
* Strong network infrastructure security background across both on\-prem physical components (firewalls, IDS/IPS, remote access) and cloud security services (Zscaler, Azure, AWS), plus experience with Zscaler ZDX and microsegmentation (Zscaler and/or Guardicore).
* Strong knowledge of the Fortinet security suite (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) and experience testing and implementing security\-related changes in a production environment.
* Experience working with 3rd party vendors and managed network service providers.
* Great organisational skills.
* Strong experience of working on SIEM tools to analyze logs and correlate events.
* Solid understanding of industry standard Cybersecurity Frameworks and compliance requirements
* Experience in Enterprise level network security incidents and change Management process.
* Solid technical understanding of DMZs, security policies, secure application traffic flows, WAF, DDoS protection, SSL offloading and inspection.
* Strong knowledge of Zero Trust Network Architecture
* Experience with private and public cloud providers is a plus, (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Nutanix) particularly in connectivity, availability, resilience, and security.
* Familiarity with service now Ticketing and CMDB is desirable
* Demonstrated capability to take part as lead security engineer in multi\-phase / multi\-year network projects or programs, leading these projects to successful implementation.
* Strong technical troubleshooting skill.
* Strong vendor management experience.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills to provide clear messages to all levels.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain strategic working relationships with peers and constituents at all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated analysis and problem solving skills using innovative thinking.
* Knowledge of ITIL based practices.
* Knowledge of Python and automation skills are desirable.
  

Qualifications


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other applicable discipline.
* 8\+ years of proven, hands\-on network security experience at global enterprise organizations, including significant experience owning and operating a Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) environment at scale.
* Network security Professional level certification preferred (e.g. Zscaler ZDTA/ZCCP/ZCCA, Fortinet NSE, Imperva, etc.); Zscaler certification strongly preferred.
* CISSP, CEH, CISM or CISA certifications is a plus.

For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit www.johnsoncontrols.com/careers.

title: Manager, Quality Engineering
description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
  

  

For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off\-the\-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
  

  

Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.


**Title** : Manager, Quality Engineering


**Reporting to** : Sr Director, Quality Engineering


**Location** : Bangalore, India


**Department** : Quality Engineering


**About Quickbase**

At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.


For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off\-the\-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we're building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.


Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We're a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.


**About the Role**

As a Quality Engineering Manager, you will own the quality strategy for a significant product domain while leading a talented team of Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams. Through your partnership with other Quality Engineering (QE) leaders, you’ll help shape and evolve our quality tooling and practices and continue to build a culture where quality is a shared responsibility.


Our teams support quality efforts across multiple product domains, invest heavily in automation, and embrace AI\-assisted development. This role requires technical judgement, strong people leadership, and the ability to build trust across teams.


Success in this role is measured by the quality of the software your team helps deliver, the growth of the quality engineers you lead, and your ability to influence how quality is built into the software development lifecycle.


**What You'll Do**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams and product initiatives.
* Own the quality strategy for a product domain by partnering closely with other leaders, tech leads, and product managers to improve software quality, delivery predictability, and customer outcomes.
* Provides technical and architectural leadership in test automation, frameworks, CI/CD, and testing standards.
* Partner with QE leadership to define and evolve scalable quality practices and AI\-assisted testing solutions, translate those into clear team priorities and goals, and drive consistent adoption to improve quality outcomes
* Balance competing priorities across multiple engineering teams, helping stakeholders understand tradeoffs while ensuring the highest\-value work receives appropriate quality investment.

Coach and mentor through clear, actionable feedback * \- developing technical and leadership capabilities, clarifying promotion expectations, and supporting career growth.
* Lead teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and organizational change while maintaining focus, engagement, and delivery excellence.

Influence engineering teams to build quality earlier in the software development lifecycle through collaboration, data, and thoughtful decision\-making.  
* 

**About You**

You believe quality engineering is much more than finding defects — it's a shared engineering responsibility woven into how software gets built. You also lead by helping others do their best work, and you measure your own success by theirs.


You will be successful in this role if you:


* Build trust quickly with your team and other leaders and teams in the organization.
* Lead with curiosity, active listening, empathy, and thoughtful communication.
* Make informed decisions in an environment where priorities can change or information is incomplete.
* Balance customer needs, quality, delivery timelines, and business priorities when making tradeoffs
* Create an inclusive, collaborative environment where individuals feel empowered to learn, experiment, and continuously improve.
* Believe your success is a reflection of the success, engagement, and growth of your team.

**Experience We Think You'll Need**

* Demonstrated success managing and developing a high\-performing Quality Engineering team.
* Experience with or working knowledge of AI\-assisted software development; including AI assisted test generation, model evaluation, and skills/playbooks.
* Experience developing and scaling quality processes that drive greater efficiency and support organizational growth.
* Experience leading and working with distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.
* Understanding of fundamental quality engineering strategies and practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions on teams without direct authority.

**Why Quickbase?**

At Quickbase, Quality Engineering is a strategic partner in how software is built and this role carries real scope: you’ll help shape and evolve our quality strategy not just execute someone else's plan.


Quality Engineering is also at an inflection point. We're actively building what AI\-assisted quality engineering looks like in practice, and this role has direct influence over how that evolves — not adopting a playbook someone else already wrote.


You'll do this alongside the rest of the QE leadership team \- sharing practices, tackling problems together, and growing together. You won't be leading in isolation.


If you want a role where your decisions shape how quality is built across a growing organization, and you want to help define what quality engineering looks like in an AI\-driven future, we'd love to talk.

  

  

**Important Notices**  

**Recorded Interviews.** Quickbase uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription.
  

**Interview Integrity.** AI is part of how we work at Quickbase — we expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged throughout the selection process. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.
  

**How We Review Applications** We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, schedule interviews, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.

  

  

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Quickbase is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply – even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

title: Applications Engineering, Staff Engineer
description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India


**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18845 **Date posted** 09/15/2026
### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years deep in the realities of chip design, where a power integrity issue at 3nm can cost months and millions, and you have learned that the gap between a tool that works in theory and one that closes timing on a real SoC is everything. You think in terms of deployment, not demos. You know what it takes to get an EDA solution from product spec to production use at a top semiconductor company, and you care about making that path shorter and cleaner every time.


You are comfortable sitting with a customer architect who is three weeks from tapeout, diagnosing a signal integrity failure, and walking out with a plan that actually works. You do not wait for perfect documentation. You dig into the design, ask the right questions, and move. You have worked across ASIC physical design, power or signal integrity closure, or custom circuit simulation, and you understand how those worlds connect when you are trying to ship silicon that actually functions.


At Synopsys, you will work with the Ansys EDA portfolio, deploy it at companies building the most advanced chips in the world, and help shape what the tools become next.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Deploy Synopsys Ansys EDA products at top semiconductor companies working on leading\-edge SoCs and 3DICs at 7nm, 5nm, and 3nm nodes
* Work directly with global customers, IP providers, and foundries to understand design challenges around power integrity, signal integrity, reliability (EM, ESD, thermal), advanced timing, jitter, and packaging
* Collaborate with software developers, architects, and product specialists to translate customer challenges into EDA product specifications and drive product development
* Use the Ansys Seascape platform to solve big\-data design challenges across chip, package, and system levels
* Provide expert technical guidance and consultation to customers globally, helping them close power, signal, and reliability issues on real designs
* Diagnose complex design failures, reproduce issues, and work with engineering teams to deliver solutions that hold up in production
* Travel occasionally to customer sites for deployment support, technical reviews, and design problem\-solving

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable the world's leading semiconductor companies to tape out chips at 7nm, 5nm, and 3nm by solving power, signal, and reliability challenges they cannot close without your expertise
* Shape the next generation of Synopsys Ansys EDA tools by feeding real customer pain points directly into product development
* Reduce time to closure for customers facing critical design bottlenecks, turning weeks of debug into days with the right deployment and guidance
* Build long\-term technical relationships with architects and design teams at top\-tier semiconductor companies, becoming their trusted resource for advanced node challenges
* Drive adoption of the Seascape platform across the industry, proving out its value on real, complex designs
* Influence foundry and IP provider roadmaps by surfacing design trends and tool gaps you see across multiple customer engagements
* Mentor application engineers and expand the team's collective expertise in power integrity, signal integrity, and reliability at scale

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or related field, and 5\+ years of related experience, or Master's degree with 3\+ years of experience
* Hands\-on experience in ASIC physical design, power integrity/signal integrity/reliability closure, or custom circuit design and simulation
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues in real customer design environments
* Solid programming skills in scripting languages like Python, Tcl, or Perl for automation and workflow development
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to customers and internal teams
* Willingness to travel occasionally to customer sites for deployment and technical support
* Experience with EDA tools for power analysis, signal integrity, or reliability verification is a strong plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a customer meeting with incomplete information, ask three sharp questions, and leave with a clear picture of what is actually broken and what needs to happen next
* You are comfortable context\-switching between a product development discussion in the morning and a customer debug session in the afternoon without losing the thread of either
* You push back when a product spec is too vague or a deployment plan does not account for how customers actually work, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward
* You do not need to be the loudest person in the room, but when you speak, people listen because you have done the work and you know what you are talking about
* You are organized enough to manage multiple customer engagements, product feedback loops, and internal projects at once without dropping details that matter
* You genuinely enjoy learning new technology and figuring out how to make it work in messy, real\-world conditions

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You will be part of the Applications Engineering team deploying Synopsys Ansys EDA products globally. The team works closely with software developers, architects, product specialists, and customers at top semiconductor companies to drive product development and deployment on leading\-edge SoCs and 3DICs. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, regional focus, and current customer engagements during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Software Dev Engineer – Generative AI & Agentic Applications
description:
**SonicWall** is a cybersecurity forerunner with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner\-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real\-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud\-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose\-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. For more information, visit **www.sonicwall.com** or follow us on **Twitter**, **LinkedIn**, **Facebook** and **Instagram**.

  


**Position Summary**



We are hiring a Software Dev Engineer to design, build, test, and deploy AI\-powered applications. You will work across the full application lifecycle — from architecture and implementation through automated testing, CI/CD deployment, and production monitoring — building features that put large language models and agentic tooling to work inside SonicWall's internal systems.



This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone with 6–8 years of professional software development experience who is comfortable owning services end to end: writing production\-quality code, integrating LLM and agentic APIs, standing up reliable data and retrieval pipelines, and shipping through a disciplined test\-and\-release process. You will collaborate closely with senior engineers, product stakeholders, and platform teams to turn requirements into dependable, well\-tested applications.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Develop AI applications:** Design and build features and services that use LLM and agentic capabilities — prompting, tool/function calling, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and orchestration — to solve real internal business problems.
* **Write production code:** Implement clean, maintainable, well\-documented backend and integration code in C\# and .NET, following established architecture and coding standards.
* **Test thoroughly:** Write unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests; build and maintain automated test suites; validate output quality and correctness for AI\-driven features before release.
* **Deploy and operate:** Package, deploy, and support applications through CI/CD pipelines; monitor performance, reliability, and cost in production; troubleshoot and resolve issues quickly.
* **Integrate with enterprise systems:** Connect applications to internal and third\-party systems and data sources via REST/JSON APIs, MCP servers, and the iPaaS layer, respecting access controls and data\-handling rules.
* **Engineer for quality and safety:** Implement evaluation, guardrails, logging, and observability so AI features behave predictably and safely at production scale.
* **Collaborate cross\-functionally:** Work with senior engineers, product owners, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs, and participate actively in code review.
* **Document and hand\-off:** Produce clear technical documentation and runbooks so applications are supportable by the broader team.


**Required Qualifications**


* **Experience:** 6–8 years of professional software development experience, including building and shipping production applications.
* **Programming:** Strong proficiency in C\# and .NET, plus solid REST/JSON API design skills.
* **AI application development:** Hands\-on experience building applications that integrate LLMs — prompting, function/tool calling, RAG, and use of orchestration frameworks such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* **Testing:** Practical experience with automated testing — unit, integration, and end\-to\-end — and a disciplined approach to quality assurance.
* **Deployment:** Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), containerization (Docker), and deploying and operating applications in the cloud.
* **Databases:** Working experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB); comfortable design schemas and writing efficient queries.
* **Cloud fundamentals:** Solid experience with Microsoft Azure, version control (Git), and observability/monitoring practices.
* **Problem solving:** Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous requirements into a working, tested, and deployable solution.
* **Communication:** Strong written and verbal English; able to explain technical trade\-offs clearly to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* **Agentic tooling:** Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable agentic orchestration frameworks.
* AI platform: Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry (good to have).
* **LLM platforms:** Practical experience with Anthropic Claude, Claude Code, or the Claude Agent SDK, or equivalent LLM provider platforms.
* **Vector search:** Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate) and retrieval pipeline design.
* **Containers \& orchestration:** Familiarity with Kubernetes (e.g., Azure Kubernetes Service) or similar container\-orchestration platforms.
* **Enterprise applications:** Familiarity with Salesforce, Snowflake, Oracle EBS, or similar enterprise application landscapes.
* **Industry background:** Experience in security, SaaS, or B2B technology sectors.

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
TechGrove is the
 **Centre of Excellence** 
 for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long\-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer\-focused environment where people can do their best work.
 



**Principal AI Engineer** 




*TechGrove AI Engineering Pod* 




 You build the intelligent features that make software feel like magic, and you make them work in production. You are equally at home shipping a clean API, standing up a RAG pipeline, evaluating an agent, or tuning guardrails so an LLM behaves safely at scale. You are excited by the current moment in AI and pragmatic about where it actually adds value.
 



 As Principal AI Engineer, you design and build the AI capabilities that differentiate an OpCo’s modernized applications: GenAI features, agentic workflows, and ML\-powered functionality, integrated safely and reliably. You work side by side with the Technical Lead / Architect, contribute as a strong full\-stack engineer, and help the whole pod raise its game in AI\-native development.
 



 If you want to turn the frontier of applied AI into shipped, dependable product features, this role is for you.
 


**About the Pod** 

 A TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self\-contained, AI\-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan’s AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match.
 



 A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high\-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan’s India\-based TechGrove.
 


**What You Will Do** 
* **Ship production AI/ML features:** 
 Design, build, and deploy GenAI integrations, agentic workflows, RAG and GraphRAG systems, and ML\-powered functionality into the OpCo’s modernized applications.
* **Orchestrate and integrate LLMs:** 
 Implement LLM orchestration, prompt and context engineering, guardrails, and evaluation to deliver reliable, safe, production\-grade AI.
* **Engineer cloud\-native services:** 
 Build scalable, secure, resilient services that host and serve AI capabilities, as a strong hands\-on contributor.
* **Build agents and tooling:** 
 Develop AI agents and tooling, including building and connecting MCP servers and tools, and champion agentic development practices across the pod’s SDLC.
* **Own data and retrieval:** 
 Design the data, retrieval, and vector or knowledge\-graph infrastructure that powers GenAI features, with quality, performance, and security built in.
* **Own technical design and quality:** 
 Lead design and implementation for AI features, write clean, well\-tested code, and uphold engineering standards, security, and observability.
* **Collaborate and mentor:** 
 Partner with the Architect and senior engineers, and coach the team on AI/ML engineering best practices.
* **Apply pragmatic judgment:** 
 Know where AI adds real value versus risk, and navigate a fast\-moving landscape with a clear head.


**What You Bring** 
* **Experience:** 
 8\+ years in software engineering, with significant hands\-on experience implementing ML/AI features in production.
* **Production experience on AWS or Azure (required):** 
 You have designed and built cloud\-native applications on AWS or Azure, including containers, serverless, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform). Experience limited to GCP alone does not meet this requirement, although GCP in addition to AWS or Azure is a plus.
* **Applied AI/ML:** 
 Demonstrated experience implementing GenAI capabilities (RAG and GraphRAG, LLM orchestration, prompt and context engineering, guardrail design) and/or ML features in production systems.
* **Agentic and GenAI frameworks:** 
 Hands\-on experience with GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), multi\-agent frameworks (crewAI, AutoGen, or similar), and developing AI agents and MCP servers and tools.
* **Software engineering depth:** 
 Strong full\-stack ability with solid SQL/No\-SQL and API design skills.
* **Modern tech stacks:** 
 Hands\-on production experience with at least two of: .NET Core, Python, TypeScript, and Java.
* **AI\-native tooling:** 
 Fluency with AI\-assisted development tooling (Claude Code or similar) as a daily, core part of your workflow.
* **Engineering principles:** 
 Solid grounding in DDD, design patterns, clean code, test\-driven development, and application security.
* **DevSecOps:** 
 Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and cloud\-native observability.
* **Collaboration:** 
 Strong communication and an ownership mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Nice to Have** 
* Deep LLM and vector database expertise: hybrid vector databases, knowledge graphs, and advanced prompt and guardrail design for enterprise AI safety.
* Experience fine\-tuning or evaluating models, building eval harnesses, or implementing LLM observability.
* Experience building and operating multi\-tenant SaaS at scale.
* Prior experience modernizing or re\-platforming enterprise or B2B applications.


**What Success Looks Like** 
* **First 90 days:** 
 You have shipped your first production AI feature, established reliable patterns for orchestration, retrieval, and evaluation, and the pod has a clear, safe approach to building with LLMs.
* **First 6 months:** 
 AI capabilities are a dependable, differentiating part of the product, with measured quality and guardrails, and the team is meaningfully more capable in applied AI because of your mentorship.


**Why TechGrove, Why Banyan** 
* **Permanent home, long\-term thinking:** 
 Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip.
* **Real ownership:** 
 You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the “what”; the pod owns the “how.”
* **AI\-native by default:** 
 You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build.
* **Variety with stability:** 
 Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you.
* **Growth and excellence:** 
 A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time.


**Should You Apply?** 

 We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that.
 



 We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI\-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes.
 







***Beware of Recruitment Scams***




 We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. 
 



**Protect yourself by following these steps:** 



* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an
 **@banyansoftware.com** 
 email address.
* Remember, employers will
 **never** 
 request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message,
 **do not respond** 
 — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.



 Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

**Who We Are**
 Magnit is the future of work. Serving hundreds of the world’s most recognizable brands for the past 30\+ years, Magnit offers the industry’s first holistic platform for the modern workforce. Magnit's integrated workforce management (IWM) platform supported by data, software, intelligence, and best\-in\-class services team is key to our clients’ success.
